text:
kevin: seeing a surge of remote_write timeouts from the us-west proxy to cortex, p95 scrape latency jumped and prometheus_remote_samples_total shows a big delta. Anyone seeing this?

maria: yep, dashboards spiking. Alerts firing: REMOTE_WRITE_ERRORS high and remote_write_queue_depth > 4000.

jules: :eyes: can you paste proxy logs and the relabel config? wondering if a label leak increased cardinality.

kevin: log snippet from proxy: 
```
Nov 16 07:10:12 proxy-1 remote_write.go:245: write failed: Post "https://cortex.internal/api/prom/push": context deadline exceeded
Nov 16 07:10:13 proxy-1 queue.go:87: queued_samples=4823 queued_bytes=9.8MB
Nov 16 07:10:13 proxy-1 remote_write.go:252: retrying (1/5)
```

kevin: and prometheus metric: `prometheus_remote_storage_queue_depth{instance="proxy-1:9201"} 4823`

maria: I also pulled the last 5m of label cardinality from tsdb: pod_uid cardinality jumped +120k in the last hour. That smells like a new exporter or relabel change.

jules: did we recently bump the gpu-exporter or node-exporter in us-west? last deploy log shows gpu-exporter 0.7.2 rolled 06:50.

ops-oncall: deploying rollback on gpu-exporter now to 0.7.1 in us-west; but we should also consider a relabel drop for container/instance specific labels.

kevin: checking prom config, remote_write relabel_configs currently: 
```yaml
- source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_name]
  action: replace
  target_label: job
- source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_app]
  action: keep
```
No labeldrop for container_id or pod_uid.

maria: confirmed gpu-exporter 0.7.2 started shipping a `container_id` label (k8s shim). That would create new timeseries per container restart. We should drop it upstream in scrape relabel.

jules: quick patch suggestion: add to relabel_configs: 
```yaml
- action: labeldrop
  regex: container_id|pod_uid|docker_id
```
Apply to prometheus scraping the exporters.

ops-oncall: rolling relabel change to monitoring/prometheus configmap (staging first). will patch and reload.

deploy-bot: prometheus-configmap patched by ops-oncall (rollout id: r-20231116-01) :rocket:

kevin: reloaded prometheus via `kubectl -n monitoring exec prometheus-0 -- kill -HUP 1` and verifying target relabels.

maria: after relabel change, remote_write queue depth dropped from 4.8k -> 120 within ~3m. errors decreased, 5xxs stopped. p95 scrape latency back to normal.

jules: great. follow-ups: 1) add unit test for exporter label list in our onboarding docs, 2) add alert for sudden cardinality delta on top-k labels (pod_uid, container_id) so this trips earlier, 3) check other regions for same exporter version.

kevin: created github issue infra/observability#487 for onboarding tests and doc. linking to gpu-exporter release notes.

maria: FYI I'll schedule a short postmortem doc in /docs/incident-cases and notify platform that exporters must not introduce high-card labels without opt-in.

alert-bot: REMOTE_WRITE_ERRORS alert resolved for us-west (was firing for 22m).

deploy-bot: rollback completed for gpu-exporter us-west (0.7.2 -> 0.7.1).

ops-oncall: closing the thread, ping me if anything resurfaces. :thumbsup:
